blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
AI strategy at the top is, above all, the discipline of separating the interesting from the important. Every week something appears in the media that looks urgent, and every month somebody proposes a project that would, if it succeeded, change everything. Very few of them turn out to matter. The senior leader's real job is to protect the team from chasing all of them at once, and to commit deliberately to the handful that genuinely fit the business.

The recommendation is that every senior leader build a short, honest AI portfolio: two or three projects in production, two or three in small experiment, and one or two in a deliberate "not yet" — interesting, worth watching, but not a current investment. The portfolio is reviewed every six months. Whatever is not working is killed; whatever is working is scaled. The hardest discipline is resisting the urge to say yes to everything that sounds exciting.

Over five years, the companies that do this quietly tend to end up ahead of the ones that chased every headline. Restraint, not appetite, is the scarce resource at the top.

items.q: According to the text, what is the senior leader's real job in AI strategy?
options: To delegate all AI decisions to specialists
To adopt every promising technology quickly
To protect the team from chasing everything and commit to a few things that fit
items.why: "to protect the team from chasing all of them at once, and to commit deliberately to the handful that genuinely fit the business."

items.q: What is the recommended shape of the AI portfolio?
options: One flagship project with unlimited funding
A few in production, a few in experiment, and one or two deliberately deferred
Only projects already proven by other firms
As many experiments as the budget allows
items.why: "two or three… in production, two or three in small experiment, and one or two in a deliberate 'not yet'."

items.q: What does the phrase "deliberate 'not yet'" imply about those projects?
options: They are being watched on purpose, but not funded for now
items.why: Inferência: "interesting, worth watching, but not a current investment" — é uma espera consciente, não uma rejeição.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Most exciting AI proposals never turn out to matter.
Saying yes to every promising AI project is the mark of an ambitious leader.
A portfolio should be reviewed and pruned regularly.
Restraint is harder than enthusiasm at senior level.
items.why: Inferência: o texto inteiro defende disciplina e restrição — dizer sim a tudo é exatamente o erro que ele critica.

items.q: The final line — "Restraint, not appetite, is the scarce resource at the top" — suggests that…
options: AI budgets are always too small
leaders rarely have enough enthusiasm for AI
appetite is more valuable than restraint
what senior leaders most lack is the discipline to say no
items.why: Inferência: "scarce" aplica-se à restrição — o que falta no topo é a capacidade de recusar, não a vontade de fazer.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James conduzindo a primeira revisão formal do portfólio de IA. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Right, thank you all for coming. This is our first formal AI portfolio review, and I want to be honest about what it is for. It is not a celebration of everything we have started. It is a decision about what we keep.

I have looked closely at the twelve initiatives on the board, and I am going to recommend that we close three of them today. Not because the people behind them did anything wrong — quite the opposite. They are well built and well intentioned. But each of them is interesting rather than important, and every one of them is quietly pulling attention away from the work that actually moves the business.

What I do want to protect is the demand-forecasting pilot. It never made much noise, it never asked for much budget, and for eight straight months it has outperformed everything else we run. So I propose that we take the people we free up today and put them behind it. Scale the one thing that is working; stop feeding the things that merely sound exciting.

We will meet again in six months, and I would ask that we hold ourselves to the same test then — kill honestly, scale honestly, and resist the urge to say yes to every headline.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does James define the purpose of this review?
options: A decision about what the team keeps
A celebration of everything the team has started
A budget request for new projects
items.why: "It is not a celebration… It is a decision about what we keep."

items.q: Why is James closing the three projects?
options: Because a competitor built them first
Because the teams behind them performed poorly
Because they are interesting rather than important and pull attention away
items.why: "each of them is interesting rather than important, and… pulling attention away from the work that actually moves the business."

items.q: What is notable about the demand-forecasting pilot?
options: It was the most expensive initiative
It attracted the most media attention
It quietly outperformed everything else for eight months on little budget
items.why: "it never asked for much budget, and for eight straight months it has outperformed everything else."

items.q: What does James suggest by praising the teams before cutting their projects?
options: That the decision is not final
That he is reluctant to lead the review
That the projects will be revived next quarter
That killing a project is not a judgement on the people's competence
items.why: Inferência: ele separa a qualidade do trabalho da decisão de encerrar — bom trabalho ainda pode não ser prioridade.

items.q: How would you best describe James's approach in this meeting?
options: Disciplined and candid, but respectful of the teams
items.why: Inferência: ele corta com clareza mas elogia as equipes e propõe um teste recorrente — firme, honesto e respeitoso.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The hardest part is the discipline of saying no to good ideas." Here, discipline means…
options: the consistent self-control to stick to a rule
items.why: Discipline = disciplina: o autocontrole constante para manter a regra, mesmo quando é difícil.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good review must ___ what is interesting from what is genuinely important."
items.why: To separate = separar: distinguir uma coisa da outra, tese central da lição.

items.q: "The forecasting tool has finally moved into production." This means it is…
options: live and being used in real operations
items.why: In production = em produção: já rodando de verdade, não mais em teste.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We should ___ the pilot that is working and stop funding the ones that only sound exciting."
items.why: Scale = escalar/ampliar aquilo que funciona; o par oposto na lição é 'kill' o que não funciona.

items.q: "He resisted the urge to approve every new proposal." An urge is…
options: a strong impulse to do something
items.why: Urge = impulso: o desejo forte e imediato — aqui, de dizer sim a tudo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em revisões de estratégia de IA. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The board still has to sign off on the revised AI portfolio." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We plan to roll out the model to one region before going global." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two directors pushed back on killing the chatbot project." They…
options: resisted or disagreed with the decision
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "They agreed to review the portfolio every six months, but never followed through." They…
options: failed to carry the commitment to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim aquilo que foi combinado.

items.q: "Ten small pilots that never scale won't move the needle on revenue." This means they will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível no resultado.
